prompt: This code throws a compile error. Why?
choices: MouseListener cannot be instantiated as an anonymous class
Anonymous class doesn't implement all 5 methods of MouseListener
explanation: MouseListener is an interface with 5 abstract methods. An anonymous class must implement all of them: mouseClicked, mousePressed, mouseReleased, mouseEntered, mouseExited. Fix: extend MouseAdapter instead, which provides empty implementations of all 5.
